release version

  • CURIE: gmeow:releaseVersion
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/releaseVersion
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

The version designation of a release — e.g. 'v1.0.0', '2.1.0-beta.3'. Not functional: competing version schemes may coexist (Principle 9).

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:Release -> rdfs:Literal

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:releaseVersion from gmeow:Release to rdfs:Literal when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
